transcript: If every morning on an empty stomach you smash a glass of salt water, you're not just waking up, you're firing up an ancient body upgrade that would make even the mighty generals of the old Chinese army stand in awe. First, your skin. The minerals in sea salt pull out hidden toxins like a wise healer draws out sickness. Soon wrinkles fade, blemishes vanish, and your face begins to glow like morning light after the storm. Second, your mouth. Salt water is the oldest medicine known to man. It destroys the bad spirits of decay, melts away plaque, and your breath becomes as fresh as the wind from the yellow mountains. Third, the great cleansing. The salt moves through your body like a flowing river, clearing waste and renewing every cell. No need for expensive tonics or strange powders. Nature already gave you everything. Fourth, the healing power. Cuts close, nails harden, skin repairs itself. Salt has the spirit of protection, strong, pure and ancient. So remember, one glass each morning, and you stop being soft like wet rice. You become strong, steady, like iron from the earth. Share this wisdom, my student. And if you wish to learn more old secrets of nature, comment yes and follow, so the teachings of the ancients never fade away.
